system.description: When you deal damage to a target by making a Lightsaber attack on your turn, you can use a Swift Action before the end of your turn to activate this Talent. If you do so, allies adjacent to the target at the time you make the attack gain a +2 circumstance bonus to melee attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
